name: Origin Story
triggers: how did you get into tech

response.text: It started with curiosity and a broken website. I was studying engineering when my department needed a new site—I volunteered, taught myself to code, and got hooked. But I quickly realized I was more fascinated by the *how* than the *what*. How does code go from a laptop to serving millions? How do you keep systems alive at 3 AM? That obsession with deployment, scale, and reliability pulled me into the cloud. I haven't looked back since.
